messages:
nina: quick question on parity between ruby and go SDKs: behavior for 401 during streaming requests. ruby client retries the stream by reconnecting but loses sent metadata (client-side). go SDK cancels and surfaces error. Which should we standardize on?

rafael: i think surface the error to caller for streaming, avoid silent reconnects. apps need to decide semantics.

priya: context: onboarding sampleapp relies on ruby's reconnect and hides intermittent auth refresh races. New users hit confusing partial outputs. I'd prefer consistent explicit error so sampleapps fail fast and show clear mitigation steps.

nina: ok that matches my concern. we had an old issue where silent reconnects masked token expiry and made debugging impossible.

rafael: open to changing ruby to match go. we'll need a minor semver bump and note in breaking changes. also add an opt-in helper that performs automatic reconnect if apps want it.

priya: can someone open a PR with tests? include a minimal sampleapp test that simulates token expiry mid-stream and asserts error is returned (no silent retry). Also update onboarding docs to call out retry helper.

nina: i'll draft the PR and a changelog entry. tagging ci-bot to run matrix for ruby versions 3.1/3.2 and quickstart sampleapp.

ci-bot: CI queued: ruby-sdk/stream-retry-parity (#301) running tests across 3.1,3.2. ETA ~8m.

rafael: thanks. once CI green we'll ship as 1.5.0 and add sampleapp note.

priya: great. this should reduce onboarding confusion and make behavior predictable across languages.

nina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/301 — implements explicit stream error on auth failure, adds helper reconnect_stream, updates docs and sampleapp test.

ci-bot: CI passed: ruby-sdk/stream-retry-parity (#301).

rafael: reviewed and left one nit about test flakiness timing. LGTM after nit.

nina: fixed nit and merged. published 1.5.0. updated onboarding guide.

priya: verified sampleapp now surfaces clear error and docs include migration note. thanks!
